scientific_integrity: Classical Mobius formula, Dirichlet, primitive roots and LTE are prior tools. No independent review or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for prime-power polynomial degrees; the Fermat-prime infinitude problem is not solved. General integer-valued polynomial fixed-divisor theory predates the claim; specialist necklace literature may contain equivalent coverage. Finite script checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
title: Exact universal divisors of prime-power irreducible-polynomial counts and Fermat-prime detection
